title: Cosy scarf
desc: Soft knitted wrap: a ribbed (lengthwise ribs, geometry + vertex colour) ring around the belly at y~0.47..0.50 that curves round the sides and ends behind the arms, a chunky ribbed knot at the side-front (x~+0.27), and two ribbed tails (slight flare) with a fringe hanging to y~0.22 / 0.29. Top of the wrap at the centre is y<=0.54, below the mouth keep-out.
convention: anchor_rest = front surface at (0, 0.47), z=0.5055 ('neck' = the chest just under the mouth: there is no neck on an egg). Rest-space offsets, same carry.
deform_class: wrap surface_bound (follows belly); knot rigid; tails surface_bound at the top and may swing (hang from the knot)
revision: polish pass 2026-10-19 (previous export kept as scarf_cosy_old.obj/.json)
